steps.title: Set Up PCR Reactions
steps.instruction: Prepare the reaction mixture for use on a Rotor-Gene 6000 / Rotor-Gene Q 5-plex (using 100-place rotor discs) or an ABI 7500 Fast real-time machine.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a total reaction volume of 20µL per reaction, including sufficient volume for the number of reactions plus a 'dead volume' (usually 2 extra), adjusting for robotic dispensers if necessary.
Dispense 15µl of the reaction mix into each reaction well.
Add 5µl of template (extracted RNA, controls, or NTC/nuclease-free water) to reach a total reaction volume of 20µl.

steps.title: Analyze Results
steps.instruction: Evaluate the real-time fluorogenic PCR results based on the following satisfactory positive criteria:

substeps.instruction: Confirm a sigmoidal curve (horizontal start, upward curve, exponential rise, and horizontal plateau phase).
Verify a suitable level of fluorescence intensity compared to a positive control.
Ensure the fluorescent curve clearly exceeds a defined threshold (CT) value situated early in the log-linear phase.
Classify results as negative if the CT value is > 40 cycles.
Confirm that NTCs do not produce a curve.
